title: How will you use Zaylo?
subtitle: Choose the profile that best fits you. You can always change your mind and explore other features later.
buyerDescription: Browse catalogs, save your profile, and checkout faster when your buyer area is ready.
sellerDescription: Create a public store, upload items, and manage your catalog from the seller dashboard.
showcaseDescription: Organize your wardrobe, build looks, and share your profile when you decide.
